notes.title: RestorArt: Horizon Bay launch!
notes.content:
Hey MixoGames fans!

RestorArt 2 is finally here!

  Brilliant puzzles that'll keep you happily busy
  Gorgeous artwork that's simply beautiful to look at
  Relaxing fun - perfect for unwinding after a long day

Launch Special: RestorArt - Horizon Bay (Collector's Edition)
is on offer for a limited time to celebrate the release!

Happy puzzling!
The MixoGames Team
